final_verdict.summary: The footage matches the earliest copy found, published on 2026-08-09 (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3ce4hJZiX1M, date independently fetched per yt-dlp metadata), before the claimed event date 2026-08-26. Matcher evidence: 12 temporally consistent frame(s), up to 37 inliers. This shows the footage was previously published; it does not by itself show the footage is fake or that the claimed event did not happen. Separately, the AI visual clues report 3 unverified observation(s) that clash with the claim (e.g. "no visible text, sign, landmark, or geographic identifier confirms Bhotekoshi or Nepal", frame ref [0, 20, 27, 40, 47]); these are model observations, not independent evidence and not part of the visual-match proof.
limits: A visual match proves shared footage ('previously published'), not that a claim is false or that the footage is fake.
Upload dates are platform metadata (or an archive snapshot date, an upper bound) for the copy found; the earliest copy found is not necessarily the original source.
Search is not exhaustive: memory covers only indexed clips, reverse search rarely finds originals, and heavy crops/edits can evade hash shortlisting.
'Not found' means not found by these adapters, not that no earlier copy exists.
